Wests Tigers 28 6 0 0 24 2004–05 London Broncos 42 12 0 0 40 2006–14 Penrith Panthers 206 102 0 0 408 Total 276 120 0 0 472 Representative Years Team Pld T G FG P 2007 USA 1 0 0 0 0 Source: [ 1 ] As of 16 January 2019 Mark O'Halloran (born 6 March 1981) is a former professional rugby league footballer who played for the Wests Tigers and the Penrith Panthers in the NRL , and the London Broncos in the ESL . His junior club was Burwood United in the Balmain District Competition. O'Halloran's position of choice was as a centre although he had also played as a wing , a defensive second rower, and briefly played five eighth in the English Super league. Background [ edit ] O'Halloran was born in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia . Playing career [ edit ] O'Halloran made his NRL début for Wests Tigers in 2001 and played 28 first grade games, mostly as a centre. In 2004, O'Halloran moved to England, where he played in the Super League for the London Broncos . O'Halloran returned to Australia

as a centre. In 2004, O'Halloran moved to England, where he played in the Super League for the London Broncos . O'Halloran returned to Australia from England and played for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. O'Halloran played in the USA international team having played one game in 2007. Post playing [ edit ] Since retiring, O'Halloran has become a PD/H/PE teacher and currently works at St Patrick's College, Strathfield .
